title: Crisis Simulation Command Portal
tagline: A command portal for planning, running, scoring, and learning from cyber crisis simulations.

book.title: Artificial Intelligence for Security Culture Transformation
book.author: Musaab Hasan
book.alignment: Chapter 10: Use of Digital Twins and Simulations for Crisis Scenarios
book.theme: Crisis labs, ransomware exercises, cross-functional decision-making, and resilience rehearsal.

dimensions.label: Scenario Realism
dimensions.description: Measures realism of technical, operational, and stakeholder injects.

dimensions.label: Decision Velocity
dimensions.description: Tracks time from signal to coordinated decision.

dimensions.label: Role Clarity
dimensions.description: Measures whether crisis roles and decision rights are understood.

dimensions.label: Communication Quality
dimensions.description: Assesses internal, executive, customer, and regulator messaging.

dimensions.label: Recovery Alignment
dimensions.description: Connects response actions to recovery objectives and dependencies.

dimensions.label: Lessons Conversion
dimensions.description: Tracks whether exercise lessons become funded improvements.

workflows: Design a scenario with business, technical, legal, and communications injects.
Assign participants, observers, decision owners, and evidence collectors.
Run the simulation and capture decision timing, assumptions, and gaps.
Convert lessons learned into owners, deadlines, and retest criteria.
evidence_examples: Assessment score movement with dated evidence.
Documented behavior observations from simulations or operational workflows.
Leadership review notes, action owners, and completed improvement tasks.
